audit.whatIsWrong: The entry never mentions that Wind Slash is a projectile, so the single most valuable use of Rebuttal in this matchup is absent. It also never names one Riven ability.
audit.why: Blade of the Exile grants Wind Slash, a ranged projectile — the only projectile in Riven's entire kit. Broken Wings, Ki Burst and Valor are all melee-range or dashes that Rebuttal cannot turn around, so Wind Slash is the one spell Mel's reflect can actually send back, and it is the spell Riven uses to finish a target who escaped the melee combo.
audit.corrected: Say that Blade of the Exile's Wind Slash is a projectile and that Rebuttal is the answer to it; name Broken Wings, Ki Burst, Valor and Blade of the Exile throughout.
sources: champ-data/_kits/riven.json (Riot Data Dragon: R flagged projectile)

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Bait the combo, eat it with W, punish the cooldown' never says which cooldown or how long it is.
audit.why: Valor is 10/9/8/7/6s and Ki Burst is 11/10/9/8/7s; Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s. The punish window is not Broken Wings — it is Valor, because that dash-shield is the only thing that gets her out of a landed snare, and at rank 1 it is gone for ten seconds.
audit.corrected: Give the numbers: Ki Burst 11s, Valor 10s at rank 1, and commit once the shield-dash is spent.

audit.why: Level 6 being Riven's spike rather than Mel's is right — Blade of the Exile adds range and a second wave of damage on top of the melee combo, and the content already flags it as a knife-edge rather than a Mel window.
